home.aboutP1: MyDebate is a single platform built for the debate and Model United Nations community.
home.aboutP2: It solves the problem of scattered information by bringing tournaments, conferences and educational events together in one place.
home.aboutP3: You can quickly find events that suit you, compare them and decide whether to take part — without digging through group chats and social media.
